items.title: fix(ui): coalesce initial foundation chunks within boot budgets
items.summary: fix(ui): coalesce initial foundation chunks within boot budgets Separate already-initial foundation dependencies from the dense UI source-size partition cap. Preserve the initial module boundary and emitted gzip gates. Group the Solid login gate and shared plugin schema with their existing runtime owners and regenerate the measured boot manifest. Original production build reproduced 36 chat requests against the unchanged 35 limit. Final build: chat 35, new-session 30, startup 8 requests and 420845 bytes gzip; largest ordinary chunk 194.1 KiB. All 29 build/copy cases and 25 login browser cases pass, production and owning UI types/lint pass, and fresh independent P2 review is clean.
